notes: Nangong's wings, checked against canon. Her feathered wings and halo are real (the only real ones in the group), but the wings sit on mechanical mounts with screws and release-valve fittings marked "Suriel", over two jagged X-shaped scars on her upper back. The game never explains the scars or says whether the wings are partly prosthetic, so she doesn't either: she deflects if asked and guards where the wings join her back.
